scope: Documentation-only source/test contract comments; exact snapshots preserve executable behavior and do not test comment wording.

tests.description: Existing Settings creation/reload icon and distinct-date order journeys, plus observed description-clearing PATCH and UI updates.

cases.contract: Ring selection survives reload into edit-form prefill and Home Gem/amber rendering.
cases.limit: One selected icon; no claim that every icon is covered.

cases.contract: Three distinct future dates display chronologically after reload.
cases.limit: Display order cannot identify the sorting layer; same-date created_at ties are not exercised.

cases.contract: Pass-through PATCH carries description:null and returns HTTP 200; Settings and Home remove the description.
cases.limit: No reload follows the clear; separate post-reload durability is not asserted.

fixture_usage: events helper pair cleanup and local date functions
tests.selector_verification: Existing executable selectors preserved; parent will execute canonical files after snapshot byte verification. No live selector exploration performed.

tests.description: Existing browser integration of production authSlice actions, interaction callbacks, and PokeKissInterface badge with retained service callbacks.

cases.contract: Signed-out and returned-same-account lifetimes reject retained old callbacks; current callback updates store and badge.
cases.limit: Local identities and controlled service callbacks; no sign-in form, Supabase auth event, or live Realtime transport.

cases.contract: Account switch clears prior account records; late old callback cannot contaminate the new account store or badge.
cases.limit: Exercises production state and rendered badge through a browser harness, not authenticated server delivery.

cases.contract: Same-user refresh preserves callback delivery and current records; duplicate IDs do not inflate counts; viewed records do not increase unread counts.
cases.limit: The refresh is direct setAuthUser invocation; no token-refresh protocol or Supabase auth-event wiring assertion.

tests.execution_kind: browser integration with controlled JavaScript service callbacks
tests.selector_verification: Existing executable selectors preserved; parent will execute canonical files after snapshot byte verification. No live selector exploration performed.

fixture_generation: None. Reuse canonical fixture implementation; parent handles artifact snapshots and aggregation.

playwright_utils_deviations.reason: Browser integration drives production authSlice actions with local identities so old callbacks remain callable. There is no authentication HTTP or HAR traffic; authSessionEnabled is false.

HTTP/HAR interception cannot retain a JavaScript subscription callback after retirement. The harness replaces subscribeInteractions, invokes retained callbacks without filtering, and restores the prototype on disposal.

preserved_convention_limits.reason: The canonical spec uses CSS attribute prefixes for dynamic event test IDs and svg under the identified Home card. These selectors are preserved byte-for-byte; no new selector pattern is introduced.
Mutation waits observe HTTP then closed form/visible row; no direct store wait is added because executable bodies are frozen for this documentation-only scope.
Existing pair lookup/cleanup uses the project Supabase admin fixture. No new raw APIRequestContext call or new helper is emitted.

execution: Not run by subagent; validation is parent step 4 responsibility.
summary: Prepared exact source snapshots for 6 existing E2E-runner cases in 2 canonical files: P0=2, P1=3, P2=1. Three are live Settings E2E journeys and three are browser integration ownership cases. No duplicate tests, new assertions, fixtures, or comment-text assertions were created.
